audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Irelia every stage including level 1, where she has one 600-range dash against 800-range Dark Sphere on a flat 7s cooldown.
audit.why: At rank 1 Bladesurge needs a target inside 600 and Syndra pokes freely from 800; the rest of the chart is fine at 53.95%.

audit.why: Level 3 Flawless Duet, level 6 Vanguard's Edge as pre-emptive lockdown against Unleashed Power, and first-item all-in are all real and already stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Page told you to parry spheres with Defiant Dance. W reduces PHYSICAL damage only; Dark Sphere and Force of Will are magic, and Transcendent gives Force of Will bonus TRUE damage.
audit.why: Riot W text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Syndra deals no physical damage in her kit, so W is not a defensive answer here — and stacking MR is likewise the wrong buy against the true-damage splinter.
audit.corrected: W-parry claims removed from early and phases[1].why; MR-is-wrong stated in breakdown.mid.

audit.why: Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at every rank, Dark Sphere a flat 7s, Unleashed Power 120/100/80 at 675 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned about the Unleashed Power execute threshold.
audit.why: Transcendent upgrades Unleashed Power to execute low-health targets — surviving on a sliver is not surviving.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Defiant Dance has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at every rank — count it and commit the instant it misses. - Dark Sphere is a flat 7s, so her poke never stops; her stun does. - Defiant Dance is physical-only and will not blunt a sphere. - Unleashed Power at 675 range executes, so stay above the threshold.

edits.before: First item onward, the wave is a weapon: crash it into all-ins, R the disengage, and surf the side-lane resets between objectives.
edits.after: Stacking MR is the wrong answer — Transcendent puts true damage on Force of Will. Buy Blade of the Ruined King and end her faster instead.

edits.before: Carry through the dance — the wave funds dives no cooldown can, and your R turns skirmishes into no-exit interviews.
edits.after: Carry by counting the flat 15s on Scatter the Weak: when it misses, Q-reset in, four-stack, and she has no escape at all.

edits.before: Ahead, dance louder: crash waves into Syndra's face, stun the answers, and surf resets through every river fight.
edits.after: Ahead, keep low minions alive in the wave as dash targets and take every window Scatter the Weak spends on its 15s.

edits.before: Syndra wins by landing Scatter the Weak (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Syndra wins by stunning you off a placed sphere, then finishing with Unleashed Power at 675 range — it executes, so low HP is not alive.

edits.before: At level 1-2 Syndra wants to poke from range and set up a stun off a well-placed sphere, so Irelia should shove minions to remove dash targets she'd otherwise use to close distance safely, forcing a straightforward approach instead. Once in range Irelia's trades are heavily favored since Syndra has little defense against sustained melee pressure. Use W's parry to eat a key sphere hit or auto and heal the trade back. If her stun misses, punish immediately with a full combo.
edits.after: At level 1-2 Syndra pokes with Dark Sphere every 7s from 800 range, so Irelia should keep low minions alive in the wave as Bladesurge targets rather than shoving them off, and approach from off the line between Syndra and her orbs. Once in range Irelia's trades are heavily favored since Syndra has little defense against sustained melee pressure. Do not count on Defiant Dance to eat a sphere — it cuts physical damage only. If Scatter the Weak misses, punish immediately with a full combo.

notes: Defiant Dance being physical-only is the single biggest correction here: three fields told the reader to parry a mage's magic damage with it. breakdown.wave, breakdown.early and breakdown.feeding remain Irelia-generic templates; nothing Syndra-specific was groundable in them without inventing, so they were left.
